description: This file defines a template class for HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) using various hash algorithms. It includes methods for setting the key, resetting the state, computing the result, and inputting data. It also defines specific typedefs for common hash algorithms like SHA1, SHA224, SHA256, SHA384, SHA512, and MD5.

classes.name: HMACType
classes.description: A template class implementing HMAC with a specified hash algorithm, providing key management, input processing, and result computation.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Sets the key for the HMAC, hashing it if necessary, and preparing inner and outer pads.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal hash algorithm state and prepares for new input.

methods.name: Result
methods.description: Returns the computed HMAC result, performing final hashing if not already done.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Feeds data into the hash algorithm for HMAC computation.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloaded operators to input data into the HMAC object.
